question: G20 Leaders’ Summit 2020 was held virtually on 20th and 21st November 2020 and was presided by______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The two-day summit on 21st and 22nd November 2020 was held virtually via video conference due to the coronavirus pandemic.
 
• The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia was the president of the 15th G20 Summit where its king, Salman Bin Abdulaziz chaired the meeting.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi represented India in the 15th G20 Summit Riyadh 2020.
 
• The theme of the summit was** "Realizing Opportunities of the 21st Century for All"** where all the member nations of G20 responded positively to collaborate and work together under the guidance of Saudi Arabia to focus on its three main aims:

 
• Empower People by creating an intrinsic environment for all people especially women and youth to work, live together, and thrive.
 
• Safeguard the Planet by encouraging unified efforts to protect our global commons.
 
• Shape New Frontiers by embracing long-term, bold strategies to share the benefits of innovations and technological advancement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **G20 Summit**__

 
 
• It is a Group of Twenty is an international forum for the Governments of 19 members countries and the European Union to discuss policies pertaining to important issues of world affairs.
 
• The G20 was founded in 1999 with the aim to discuss financial stability worldwide.
 
• The G20 Summit is held annually where a different G20 member assumes the chairmanship/presidency of the G20 Summit.
 
• India is set to assume the presidency of the G20 summit in 2023 a year later than planned previously.
